extraction.notes: Three months ended June 30, 2023 column from the FFO reconciliation (seq 11). Starting line is net income available for MAA common shareholders ($144,766), which is the reconciliation's first line. Two lines show an em dash for 2023 and are recorded as 0: Gain on sale of non-depreciable real estate assets and COVID-19 related costs. Mark-to-market debt adjustment is printed as (12) and recorded as -12; it is categorized as 'other' because it fits no listed category. Per-share check: 286,344/119,823 = 2.39; 273,280/119,823 = 2.28; 240,611/119,823 = 2.01. The AFFO subtracts recurring capex, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Diluted share count is in the Share and Unit Data table (seq 9); the FFO-and-AFFO count of 119,823 is used and was not taken from seq 11 separately. Net income per share and FAD items were excluded because they are below Core AFFO.
